items: A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear appropriate personal protective 
 equipment must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses, 
 safety goggles, rubber gloves and rubber apron.

The door of the battery room must be provided 
 with NO Smoking signs.

The battery instructions must be displayed 
 visibly on the wall..

Water source must be available in the battery 
 room.

When working in the battery room be aware of 
 parts under voltage.

The battery set is 
 out of service if necessary.
Inspect terminals of battery and clean any deposits with distilled water.
Cheeks for correct position of all vent covers.
Clean battery room floor with water.
Check for correct operation of battery room exhaust fan.

Measure and record the voltage and density for each cell in the 
 Maintenance Record Data Sheet MRDS
